concept.material: cast bronze with heavy dark patina
concept.internal_detail: polished brass gears and tiny tension linkages
concept.button: a flush circular push-pin at the tapered tip
concept.shell_mechanic: The fluted bronze casing slides apart into three interlocking longitudinal segments
concept.emerging_parts: Four wide toe-padded legs and a flat jointed skull
concept.signature_move: its jointed bronze jaw plates open slightly on their pivot and click shut again, and its tail segment twitches once on a tiny internal spring
concept.turkish: wall gecko: Duvar gekosu (Evlerin duvarlarinda dolasan, tirmanici surungen) — ribbed fluted spindle, cast bronze with heavy dark patina

concept.material: burnished copper and dark weathered wood
concept.internal_detail: miniature brass bevel gears and sliding pistons
concept.button: a small brass push-stud at the narrow tip
concept.shell_mechanic: The biconical wooden spindle separates down its middle seam and the upper and lower halves hinge outward
concept.emerging_parts: Two folded metal wings and a hooked beak head
concept.signature_move: its ruby glass eyes light up red, and its hinged beak plates swing open and snap shut once with a sharp mechanical click
